product_overview: Gardiyan is an Android app that lets users set daily usage limits on selected apps and enforces those limits with an overlay lock screen when the app is brought to the foreground. It also includes management for restricted apps and custom motivational quotes.
core_goals: Track and enforce daily time limits for selected applications
Detect when restricted applications come to the foreground and block access when limits are exceeded
Allow users to add, update, list, and remove application restrictions
Support saving and deleting custom motivational quotes
Provide a simple local Android experience without requiring external API keys

features.name: Restriction Management
features.description: Users can add selected apps to a restricted list, view the active restrictions, and remove restrictions when they no longer want limits enforced.
user_flows: POST /restrictions/add with a valid app restriction payload -> Receive 200 Success -> GET /restrictions/list -> Receive 200 with Restriction[] including the newly added app
DELETE /restrictions/remove with a valid restricted app identifier -> Receive 200 Success -> GET /restrictions/list -> Receive 200 with Restriction[] excluding the removed app
POST /restrictions/add with an invalid or incomplete restriction payload -> Receive a non-200 error response -> GET /restrictions/list -> Receive 200 with Restriction[] unchanged

features.name: Daily Limit Enforcement
features.description: The app monitors selected apps in the foreground and shows an overlay lock screen when a configured daily limit has been reached.
user_flows: POST /restrictions/add with a selected app and daily limit configuration -> Receive 200 Success -> App comes to the foreground and usage is tracked -> Limit reached and overlay lock screen is shown to the user
GET /restrictions/list with no active restrictions configured -> Receive 200 with an empty Restriction[] -> App foreground monitoring finds no app to enforce -> No overlay lock screen is triggered
POST /restrictions/add with a malformed daily limit value -> Receive a non-200 error response -> App foreground monitoring continues without a valid limit -> No enforcement overlay is shown

features.name: Quote Management
features.description: Users can create and manage custom motivational quotes stored locally for display within the app.
user_flows: POST /quotes/add with a valid custom quote payload -> Receive 200 with Quote -> Use the saved quote in the app’s quote list or display area
DELETE /quotes/delete with a valid quote identifier -> Receive 200 Success -> The deleted quote no longer appears in the saved quotes list
POST /quotes/add with an empty or invalid quote payload -> Receive a non-200 error response -> The quote is not saved and remains absent from the saved quotes list
